messages:
frank: Uploaded a small layout refresh for the Rules canvas — aiming to make priority and conflicts easier to scan. Figma: https://redwood.design/f/rules-canvas-refresh-v1 lina: Nice. One thing: the priority pill is currently only color. Can we show a compact number (1/2/3) and a subtle caret to indicate orderability? omar: Validation copy: current toast 'Rule error' is too opaque. Suggest 'Can't save — conflict or missing fields. Click to jump to the issue.' Also inline: 'Conflict with rule # (click to inspect)'. tess: Keyboard UX: prefer pick-up+move model: Space to pick up, Arrow keys to move, Enter to drop. Must announce new index: 'Rule moved to position 3' with aria-live="polite". Focus should remain on the moving item. frank: Good call. I'll shift the drag handle to the left so it's first tabbable element and make it 44px min touch target. Also adding a visually-hidden label: aria-label="Reorder rule". lina: Preview simulator: instead of a toggle, add a small 'Run preview' secondary button next to Save. When running, show a tiny spinner and disable only the simulator button. Emit telemetry `ui.routing.preview.run` with policy_id and sample_set. omar: Accessibility: when preview results update, announce counts and changes e.g. 'Preview updated: +5 matches'. Use a status region:
Preview updated: 5 matches
. Also ensure badges on preview rows read 'matched by #2' and are connected via aria-describedby. tess: One more microcopy: change inline disabled state from 'Overlap detected (disabled)' to 'Disabled — overlaps with active rule #2. View conflict.' Action link should focus the conflicting rule in the canvas. qa-bot: Note: add tests for keyboard reorder, preview aria-live updates, and telemetry events. CI job: ux-rules-214. frank: Action items: 1) numeric priority + caret, 2) left-side handle 44px + aria-label, 3) Space+Arrow reorder + live announcements, 4) 'Run preview' secondary button + telemetry, 5) clearer toast and inline conflict copy, 6) preview badges with aria-describedby. I'll open the PR and request design-review. Targeting patch release this week.
